subject.title: fix(secrets): surface degradation in logs and doctor

question: Should unavailable webhook-route SecretRefs be isolated as cold route failures while the rest of the Gateway remains available, rather than retaining the prior whole-Gateway startup failure behavior?
rationale: This is an intentional security and availability boundary change beyond diagnostic wording; source and tests can establish mechanics, but they cannot determine the repository’s preferred failure policy for existing deployments.

options.title: Accept route isolation with proof
options.body: Approve route-level isolation, provided the final head demonstrates generic route denial, redacted operator output, and unchanged fail-closed Gateway ingress behavior.

options.title: Keep route secrets startup-critical
options.body: Limit this PR to diagnostics and retain whole-Gateway startup failure when a webhook-route SecretRef is unavailable.

options.title: Split the policy change
options.body: Land only the diagnostic lifecycle work and defer route-isolation behavior to a dedicated security-boundary PR.

recommendation.title: Accept route isolation with proof
recommendation.body: Approve route-level isolation, provided the final head demonstrates generic route denial, redacted operator output, and unchanged fail-closed Gateway ingress behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged owner-isolation contract that this PR extends to a new owner class.
